boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#An illusion appears around #Target# making %s appear human.
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#一层幻影出现在#Target#周围，让%s看起来像人类。

entries.source: This small pendant depicts a hematite moon eclipsing a golden sun and according to legend was worn by one of the Sunwall's founders.
entries.target: 一个小小的垂饰，雕刻着赤铁矿之月遮蔽金色太阳的图案。传说它曾由太阳堡垒的建立者之一佩戴。

entries.source: Freed Derth from the onslaught of the mad Tempest, Urkis.
entries.target: 从疯狂的风暴魔导师厄奇斯的猛攻中解救了德斯镇。

entries.source: I know, I know. Where does the eel stop and the tail start? It doesn't much matter. The last ten inches or so should do nicely.
entries.target: 我知道，我知道。电鳗到哪儿为止、尾巴又从哪儿开始？其实没多大关系。最后十英寸左右就够了。

entries.source:
Corrupted vapour rises at the target location (radius 4) doing %0.2f blight damage every turn for %d turns.
		The damage increases with Spellpower.
entries.target:
腐化的蒸汽在目标位置升起（半径 4），每回合造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害，持续 %d 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Your body is more like that of an ooze.
		When you take damage, you may split and create a Bloated Ooze nearby within your line of sight.
		This ooze has as much health as twice the damage you took (up to a maximum of %d, based on your Mindpower and maximum life).
		The chance to split equals the percent of your health lost times %0.2f.
		You may have up to %d Bloated Oozes active at any time (limited by talent level and the summoning limit), and all damage you take will be split equally between you and them so long as this talent is active.
		Bloated Oozes last for %d turns, are very resilient (%d%% all damage resistance to damage not coming through your shared link), and regenerate life quickly.
		%sThe chance to split increases with your Cunning.
entries.target:
你的身体构造变得更像软泥怪。
		当你受到伤害时，你有几率分裂，并在附近视线内生成一个浮肿软泥怪。
		该软泥怪的生命值为你所受伤害的两倍（最大 %d，基于你的精神强度和最大生命值）。
		分裂几率等于你损失的生命值百分比乘以 %0.2f。
		你同时最多可以拥有 %d 只浮肿软泥怪（受技能等级与召唤上限限制）；只要本技能处于激活状态，你受到的所有伤害就会在你和它们之间平均分摊。
		每只浮肿软泥怪存在 %d 回合，极为坚韧（对并非通过共享连接传来的伤害拥有 %d%% 全伤害抗性），并能快速恢复生命。
		%s分裂几率随灵巧提升。

entries.source: Through rigorous training, you have learned to focus your actions for a short while, increasing your speed by %d%% for 5 turns.
entries.target: 通过严格的训练你已经学会在短时间内爆发你的速度，提高你 %d%% 速度 5 回合。

entries.source: You have been tasked to remove at least one of the threats to the yeeks.
entries.target: 你被派去清除对夺心魔的两大威胁之一。

entries.source: This cracked gemstone looks faded with age. It appears to have once been the eye of a golem.
entries.target: 这枚损坏的宝石看起来似乎有一定的年月了。种种迹象表明它曾经是某个傀儡的眼珠。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Flat resistances#LAST#
Reduces each hit of a certain damage type (or all) by this amount.
entries.target:
#GOLD#伤害减免#LAST#
按固定数值减免某种类型（或所有类型）伤害。

entries.source:
You summon a river of tortured souls to launch an onslaught of darkness against your foes.
		Every turn for 5 turns you launch a projectile towards the designated area that explodes in radius %d, dealing %0.2f darkness damage.
		Each projectile consumes a soul and the spell ends when it has sent 5 projectiles or when you have no more souls to use.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你召唤冥河中受折磨的灵魂，对敌人发起暗夜强袭。
		接下来 5 回合里，每回合向目标区域发射一个灵魂，产生 %d 码范围的爆炸，造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害。
		每次发射会消耗一个灵魂；累计发射 5 个灵魂，或者没有剩余灵魂的时候，法术会结束。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source: stair back to the lake of Nur
You have heard that near the Charred Scar, to the south, lies a ruined tower known as the Dreadfell.
entries.target: 你听说在灼烧之痕南部有一个叫做恐惧王座的荒塔废墟。

entries.source: Aeryn, I am sorry but one of us needs to be sacrificed for the world to go on. #LIGHT_GREEN#[sacrifice Aeryn for the sake of the world]
entries.target: 艾琳，很抱歉我们之中得有一个人牺牲才能维持这个世界的存在。#LIGHT_GREEN#[为了这个世界牺牲艾琳]

entries.source: Too late! Argh, too late. %s has already finished. I'll make the elixir and reward you as promised, but only because the Brotherhood breaks the fingers of non-member alchemists who rook people. Members, on the other hand...
entries.target: 太迟了！啊，太迟了！%s已经完成了。我会按承诺配制药剂并给你奖励，但这纯粹是因为兄弟会会折断那些坑蒙拐骗的非会员炼金术士的手指。至于会员嘛，可就另当别论了……
进入暴走（共享冷却时间）。

entries.source: #VIOLET#Your rod of recall glows brightly for a moment.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你的回归之杖短暂地闪耀起来。

entries.source: Did over 1500 damage in one attack.
entries.target: 在一次攻击中造成超过1500点伤害。

entries.source: Unleash nature's fury against foes around you.
entries.target: 向敌人释放自然的愤怒。

entries.source:
Enter a fluid, mobile shooting stance that excels at close combat. Your ranged attack speed is increased by %d%% and each time you shoot you gain %d%% increased movement speed for 2 turns.
Ranged attacks against targets will also grant you up to %d%% of a turn. This is 100%% effective against targets within 3 tiles, and decreases by 20%% for each tile beyond that (to 0%% at 8 tiles). This cannot occur more than once per turn.
Requires a sling to use.
entries.target:
进入流畅灵活的射击姿势，擅长近距离射击。你的远程攻击速度增加 %d%%，每次射击令你在两回合内移动速度增加 %d%%。
命中敌人的远程攻击将给你带来最多 %d%% 额外回合，该效果对三格以内的目标有 100%% 效果，每增加 1 格距离，效果降低 20%%（8 格降为 0%%）。该效果每回合只能生效一次。
该技能需要投石索。

entries.source: An arcane vortex follows the target. Each turn a manathrust fires from it to a random foe in sight doing %0.2f arcane damage to all. If no foes are found the main target takes 50%% more arcane damage this turn. If the target dies the remaining damage is dealt as a radius 2 ball of arcane.
entries.target: 一个奥术漩涡跟随着目标。每回合一发奥术射线从它身上释放出来，随机对附近视野内的目标造成 %0.2f 奥术伤害。如果视野内没有任何其他目标，则该回合会对初始目标附加额外的 50%%奥术伤害。如果目标死亡，残余伤害引发半径为 2 的奥术爆炸。

entries.source: #YELLOW#Items lying around will disappear in #WHITE#%d#YELLOW# turns!#LAST#
entries.target: #YELLOW#地上的物品将会在#WHITE#%d#YELLOW#回合内消失！#LAST#

entries.source: Taking on a spectral form, allowing teleportation back to their original tile.
entries.target: 进入游魂形态，可以传送回原来的位置。

entries.source: You literally dance around your foes, increasing your movement speed by %d%% and reducing the cooldown of Hack'n'Back, Rush, Disengage and Evasion by %d turns.
entries.target: 你在敌人周围跳起华丽的舞蹈，增加 %d%% 移动速度并减少燕回斩、冲锋、逃脱和回避的冷却时间 %d 回合。

entries.source: Some do not walk upon the straight road others follow. Seek the hidden paths outside the normal course of life.
entries.target: 有些人并不走他人遵循的坦途。去寻觅常规生命轨迹之外的那些隐秘路径。

entries.source: %s go to the west, and find Kruk Pride!
#VIOLET#Another foe is summoned to the arena!
entries.target: #VIOLET#又一个对手被召唤进了竞技场！
范围 %d; 强度 %d; 持续 %d%s

entries.source: Became the new master of the arena in 60-wave mode.
entries.target: 在60波模式中成为新的竞技场主宰。

entries.source: * #LIGHT_GREEN#%d%%#LAST# chance to reduce strength, dexterity, and constitution by #VIOLET#%d#LAST#%s
Player can earn Madness version of achievements if also playing in Roguelike or Adventure permadeath mode.
entries.target: 玩家如果选择永久死亡模式或冒险模式可以达成绝望难度成就。

entries.source: You cannot pick up items from the floor while asleep!
entries.target: 你不能在睡眠状态下从地上拾取物品！

entries.source: There are no shadows to heed the call!
Increases the accuracy of unarmed, melee and ranged weapons by %d.
entries.target: 增加你的徒手、近身和远程武器命中 %d 点。

entries.source: This creature has fallen into a solipsistic state and is caught up in its own egoic thoughts (-%d%% global speed).
entries.target: 目标进入唯我状态并且被自己的思维所干扰 (-%d%% 全局速度)。

entries.source:
Grants %d Physical Power when fighting unarmed (or with gloves or gauntlets).
		This talent's effects will scale with your level.
entries.target:
当你徒手或仅装备手套和臂铠时提高 %d 物理强度。
		效果受角色等级加成。

entries.source: You have laid Celia to rest, putting an end to her failed experiments. You have taken her heart, for your own experiments. You do not plan to fail as she did.
entries.target: 你埋葬了赛利亚，终结了她失败的实验，你拿走了她的心脏为自己的实验做准备，你相信你不会重蹈她的覆辙。

entries.source: Prepare which traps? (maximum: %d, up to tier %d)%s
entries.target: 准备什么陷阱？(最多%d个，最高阶级 %d)%s
附近有抛射物时获得额外格挡：

entries.source:
50%% chance that damage the caster takes will be warped to a set target.
		Once the maximum damage (%d) is absorbed, the time runs out, or the target dies, the shield will crumble.
entries.target:
施法者所承受的伤害有 50%% 的概率转移给指定连接的目标。
		一旦吸收伤害达到上限（%d），持续时间到了或目标死亡，护盾会破碎掉。

entries.source: A stream of poison gushes onto @target@!

entries.target: 你不能选择召唤物为目标！
